What We Build For You

Every service is authorized, consent-based, and built to deliver measurable impact — not just deliverables.

FortifiedBytes DevLab

Web Development

Businesses lose trust and leads because websites are slow, outdated, and not conversion-ready.

  • Modern UI/UX (mobile-first) with clean layout
  • Core pages: Home, About, Services, Contact + extras
  • Lead capture: WhatsApp, Call, Forms (anti-spam)
  • Basic SEO setup and performance optimization
  • Deployment + handover documentation
Higher trust, more leadsGet Quote →
OrbitEdge Media

Google Business Profile Setup

Local businesses miss calls because their Google Business Profile is incomplete or poorly optimized.

  • Profile setup/optimization (categories, services, keywords)
  • Photos, highlights, and credibility improvements
  • Review system (QR + scripts) for genuine reviews
  • Regular posts/updates strategy
  • Monthly reporting (calls, directions, visibility)
More local calls & map rankingGet Quote →
OrbitEdge Media

SEO Optimization

Websites stay invisible on Google, forcing businesses to rely only on paid ads.

  • SEO audit and baseline report
  • Keyword strategy + content plan
  • On-page optimization (titles, headings, internal links)
  • Technical fixes checklist (speed, indexing, schema)
  • Monthly performance reporting
Compounding organic trafficGet Quote →

No fake promises or guaranteed rankings. Process + reporting + improvements.

Microsoft Office & Excel Work

FortifiedBytes Technologies

Cybersecurity Consulting

Businesses face risk from weak security policies, misconfigurations, and poor access control.

  • Risk assessment and security posture review
  • Access control guidance (least privilege, 2FA)
  • Security roadmap and prioritized fixes
  • Policy guidance for teams (basic cybersecurity SOPs)
Lower breach risk, better complianceGet Quote →

All work is defensive and authorized. Unlawful requests are refused.

FortifiedBytes Technologies

Penetration Testing

Organizations can't fix vulnerabilities they don't know about — attackers find them first.

  • Scope agreement + written authorization required
  • Web application penetration testing
  • Network & infrastructure assessment
  • Detailed report with severity ratings + remediation
  • Re-test after fixes to confirm closure
Find before attackers doGet Quote →

Authorized engagements only. Written scope agreement mandatory.

⚠️ Our Legal Commitment

FortifiedBytes operates strictly within legal and ethical boundaries. All security work requires written authorization and a signed scope agreement. We do not perform unauthorized access, install spyware, use pirated software, or conduct any unlawful surveillance.

Any request for unlawful services will be declined and may be reported to relevant authorities. We take this seriously — not as a formality, but as a core value.

// Who We Are

Built for the Real World.

FortifiedBytes isn't a typical agency. We're a multi-brand company built by practitioners who got tired of the gap between what's promised and what's delivered.

We started FortifiedBytes with a simple belief: businesses deserve technology that actually works — built ethically, delivered transparently, and measured by real outcomes.

Too many agencies sell smoke and mirrors. Fake rankings, bloated retainers, security theater. We decided to be different — specializing in authorized cybersecurity, real web development, and compounding SEO growth.

Over time, that grew into OrbitEdge Media — our growth and branding arm — and now KOVA, our upcoming AI product that we're building to be genuinely useful for real people.

Based in India, serving clients globally. We stay small, stay sharp, and stay honest. That's the FortifiedBytes promise.
